ocaraka: [ava + cara + ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 (1) Can be entered in (the house). One who gives inside information to steal in the house. One who does the inferior action (such as killing others). (3) One who investigates. Spy. Detective.
ocarakakamma: [ocaraka + kamma] (na) CL=7 (1) The subject of one who gives inside information to steal in the house. (2) The subject of one who makes an inferior case. (3) The function of spy.
ocarakakathā: [ocaraka + kathā] (thī) CL=7 Words (sound) that are based on one who gives inside information to steal in the house.
ocarakavohāra: [ocaraka + vohāra] (pu) CL=7 The designation or name that is Ocaraka. See - Ocaraka (2) (3).
ocarati: [ava + cara + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He comes. (2) He enters into.
ocaraṇa: [ava + cara + yu] (na) CL=7 Evil deeds or inferior manners.
ocaritvā: [ava + cara + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having investigated. See - Ocaraka (3).
ocariyamāna: [ava + cara + ya + māna] (ti) CL=7 (Dhamma teachings) that causes to believe or absorb.
occhijjamāna: [ava + chida (chidi) + ya + māna] (ti) CL=7 Cut off.
occhijjanākāra: [occhijjana + ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of cutting or breaking off.
occhijjati: [ata + chida(chidi) + ya + ti] (kri) CL=7 Cuts or breaks off.
occhindamāna: [ava + chidi + a + māna] (ti) CL=7 One who blocked.
occhindati: [ava + chidi + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 One who blocks.
occhinditvā: [ava + chidi + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having blocked.
ocetuṃ: [u + ci + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To increase or develop or prosper.
oceyya: [ava + ci + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To pluck or pick.
ocinaka: [ata(u) + ci + nā + ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 Picked up or plucked. See below.
ocinakavāta: [ocinaka + vāta] (pu) CL=7 The wind that plucked (something).
ocinana: [ava + ci + nā + yu] (na) CL=7 Picking up or plucking.
ocinanta: [ava + ci + nā + anta.] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ocinantī.] One who plucks.
ocinanti: [ava + ci + nā + anti] (kri) CL=7 They pluck. See below.
ocini: [ava + ci + nā + ī] (kri) CL=7 He plucked. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocinissati: [ava + ci + nā + ssati] (kri) CL=7 He will pick or pluck. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocinissāmi: [ava + ci + nā + ssāmi] (kri) CL=7 He will pick or pluck. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocinita: [ava(u) + ci + nā + ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be plucked or picked.
ocinitaphalasākhā: [ocinitaphalā + sākhā] (thī) CL=7 The branches with fruits that should be plucked.
ocinitta: [ava + ci + nā + ā] (kri) CL=7 Plucked. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocinituṃ: [ava + ci + nā + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To pluck.
ocinā: [ava + ci + nā +ti] (na) ti (kri) CL=7 They pluck. See below.
ocināmi: [ava + ci + nā + mi] (kri) CL=7 I pluck or pick. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocināpana: [ava + ci + nā + ṇāpe + yu] (thī, na) CL=7 Plucking or picking. See - Ocinā-(na)ti.
ocināpenta: [ava + ci + nā + ṇāpe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to pluck.
ocināpessanti: [ava + ci + nā + ṇāpe + ssanti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They will cause to pluck. See - Ocināpeti.
ocināpetabba: [ava + ci + nā + ṇāpe + tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be plucked.
ocināpeti: [ava + ci + nā + ṇāpe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 Causes to pluck or pick.
ocināsi: [ava + ci + nā + si] (kri) CL=7 You pluck or pick. See - Ocinā(na)ti.
ocināyati: [ava + cine (cina)+a+ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 117. Dhātvattha. 119.] (He) thinks disrespectfully. (He) has a low opinion of someone or (he) underestimates.
ocināyatu: [ava + cine (cina) + a + tu] (kri) CL=7 Let it be contemptible. Let it be underestimated. (Let it go. Zar, T.) See above.
ocirakajātakāla: [ocī(ci)raka jāta + kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of hanging down. When fruits are hanging down in a row.
ocita: [ata + ci + ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be plucked.
[u + ci + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who acquires. (2) One who fulfills.
ocitatta: [ocita + tta] (na) CL=7 As a state of acquirement.
ocitattha: [ocita + attha] (ti) CL=7 One who has acquirement. (one who is fulfilled with prosperous wealth. Jā, sya.)
ocitya: [ucita + ṇya. ] (na) CL=7 Be suitable. Reasonableness. (Match with speech and work done. Match with the reason words (sound) and the consequence. Conformity. One who doesn"t speak out about his quality, etc.,).
ocityahīna: [ocitya + hīna] (na) CL=7 Lacks reasonableness. Without reasonable.
ocityahīnadosa: [ocityahīna + dosa] (pu) CL=7 An offense or deficiency that lacks reasonableness. A sin of without reasonable.
ocityahīnatāpatthi: [ocityahīnatā + āpatti]  CL=9 Entailing ocityahīna offence- sin; being guilty with ocityahīnadosa. If a composition or literature includes something in which words are not relevant to action and they are different from each other, something in which the preceding words showing the cause and the following words showing the result are not relevant, something in which one own quality are praised too much- exaggerated, etc., this kind of composition or literature is guilty of ocityahīnadosa. However, if one talks or writes truthfully wherever one needs to talk, there is no ocityahīna offence.)'
ocityasamullāsavedī: [ocityasamullāsa + vida + ṇī] (ti) CL=7 Knows to point out the meaning reasonably. One who knows the instruction reasonably.
ocī: [ocī(ci)raka + jāta] (ci)rakajāta (ti) CL=7 A series of (fruits) are hanging down (from the branch). Fruits are hanging down in a row under (the branch).
ocetu: [u + ci + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To increase or develop or prosper.
ocinitu: [ava + ci + nā + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To pluck.
